modes.name: Team Deathmatch

modes.tip: Stay near teammates. Don't run off alone.

hyeon-burst

modes.name: Domination
modes.what: Hold flags A, B, C for points · 6v6
modes.why: Fights around 3 flags at every range: the all-round build and a kit that heals you on caps.

hyeon-burst

modes.name: Hardpoint
modes.why: Small hill, close fights: each gun's close-range build and a hill-holding kit.
modes.tip: Sit on the hill. Leave 15 s before it moves.

m4

modes.name: Kill Confirmed
modes.what: A kill counts when you grab the tag · 6v6
modes.why: Fast fights and tag runs: an SMG first, and Tracker to find the tags.
modes.tip: Always grab the tag. Deny theirs too.
head: vel-46
m4

modes.name: Free-for-All
modes.why: Solo and fast: an SMG first, and a kit that finds enemies without teammates.
modes.tip: Keep moving. Stay out of the middle.
head: vel-46
m4

mosin-nagant

m4

m4

head: vel-46
m4

mosin-nagant

m4

m4

TDM.why: Kills are all that count: stay off their UAV and quiet; your radar pings show the whole team where they are.

Domination.why: Capping a flag restarts your health; smoke covers a cap; a Drill Charge clears a flag held behind cover.

Hardpoint.why: Holding the hill restarts your health; Trophy shoots down grenades thrown in; a Molotov burns them off the hill.

Kill Confirmed.why: Tracker shows where enemies died (that's where the tags are) and hides your own kill markers.

Free-for-All.why: No teammates to call enemies out: footprints (Tracker), a Snapshot and your own radar find fights first.

S&D.why: Stay hidden from UAVs, thermals and Snapshots and stay quiet; smoke covers a plant or defuse; a Claymore guards your back.

Hijack.why: The Spike carrier can't throw a lethal (that button throws the Spike): Stim heals the carrier, Smoke Wall screens the push, Blood Rush sprints it in.

Frontline.why: You always spawn at your base: Blood Rush gets you back to the fight; kills restart your health.

Inflation.why: Hidden from UAVs and thermals and quiet, so you keep the cash you carry.

Grind.why: Tracker shows where the tags dropped; Stim keeps you alive on the run to the bank.

Drop Zone.why: Holding the zone restarts your health; Trophy shoots down grenades thrown into it.

Ground War.why: Big map full of streaks and vehicles: Cold-Blooded hides you from AI targeting and thermals, Blood Rush crosses the lanes.

Infected.why: Survivors run out of ammo: Scavenger and a Munitions Box refill it; Fast Hands reloads faster; a mine guards your corner.

Possession.why: Non-stop close fights: kills restart your health and refill your sprint.

Hardcore.why: No health regen, so Quick Fix does nothing: Ghost instead; low health means one grenade kills, so Bomb Squad.

role_notes.rush: SMG/shotgun: Ninja instead of Blood Rush (quiet flanks).
role_notes.long: Sniper: Ghost, Ninja, Cold-Blooded (hold a lane unseen).
role_notes.marksman: Marksman kit: Ghost, Fast Hands, Cold-Blooded, Frag, Snapshot, Trophy (stay unseen, cycle fast, spot them first).

no_class.name: Gunfight

no_class.tip: No custom class. Learn the gun you're handed.

no_class.name: Gun Game
no_class.what: Every kill gives you the next gun
no_class.tip: No custom class. The game hands out guns.

no_class.name: Collateral
no_class.what: Search and Destroy where you buy gear each round
no_class.tip: No custom class. You buy guns each round.
